lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Discrete clusters of high-luminance pixels forming roughly circular blobs. These are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher density observed in the dorsal-anterior quadrant of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of low-amplitude luminance contrast intersect with horizontal bands to form a grid. The high-intensity blobs are precisely localized at these intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank shows a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with the superior edge being significantly brighter than the inferior edge.
